title: Malicious code in n8n-nodes-social-tiktok (npm)
description: The n8n-nodes-social-tiktok npm package versions 0.1.1 through 0.1.22 contain malicious code. Installation or execution of this package can lead to full system compromise, allowing an attacker to gain control over the affected computer. Users should consider any system with this package installed as compromised and rotate all secrets and keys from a different, secure machine.
